prompt: Build a clinic visits app here, not from a pack: a Patients table (full name, date of birth, phone) and a Visits table (the patient, visit date, reason, diagnosis, fee in VND), both in one app menu. Our sales reps (Nhân viên kinh doanh) work the front desk: they can view and create patients and visits, and edit what they created.
note: A clinic pack exists; the prompt asks for the app itself, so a pack recommendation alone is no proposal.
